mechanism: Bumetanide increases uric acid levels through renal tubular reabsorption, while pyrazinamide also elevates serum uric acid; combined use significantly increases hyperuricemia risk and may precipitate gout or impair pyrazinamide's tuberculostatic efficacy.
action: Monitor serum uric acid levels closely; consider alternative diuretic if possible; ensure adequate hydration and monitor for gout symptoms; assess need for urate-lowering therapy during concurrent use.
